Daenerys.prompt_ch: 一位年轻美丽的孕妇，白发黑眼，皮肤白皙。她穿着多斯拉克风格的服饰，长袍上绘有彩色图案。
Daenerys.prompt_en: A young and beautiful pregnant woman with white hair, black eyes, and fair skin. She wears Dothraki-style clothing, with colorful patterns painted on her robe.

Viserys.prompt_ch: 一个自负而疯狂的男人。他白发银眼，面容憔悴，穿着破旧的红色丝衣和黑色天鹅绒披风。
Viserys.prompt_en: A conceited and insane man. He has silver hair and pale eyes, with a gaunt face. He wears tattered red silk and a black velvet cloak.

Khal Drogo.prompt_ch: 强大的多斯拉克首领。他身材魁梧，古铜色皮肤，长长的黑发编成辫子，上面装饰着金环和铃铛。他穿着马皮裤子和彩绘皮背心，腰间系着沉重的金章腰带。他是一个威严而冷酷的战士。
Khal Drogo.prompt_en: A powerful Dothraki leader. He is tall and muscular, with bronze skin, long black hair braided with bells and gold rings. He wears horsehide pants and a painted leather vest, with a heavy golden belt around his waist. He is a stern and ruthless warrior.

Dosh Khaleen Elder.prompt_ch: 多斯拉克人的女智者，由一群年迈的老妇人组成。她们穿着朴素的长袍，脸上布满皱纹，眼神锐利。
Dosh Khaleen Elder.prompt_en: The wise women of the Dothraki, a group of elderly women. They wear plain robes and have wrinkled faces with sharp eyes.

Bloodrider.prompt_ch: 多斯拉克人的战士，穿着多斯拉克风格的服饰，手持长矛，表情严肃。
Bloodrider.prompt_en: Dothraki warriors dressed in traditional attire, holding spears and wearing serious expressions.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 夜幕降临，多斯拉克人的圣城维斯·多斯拉克被笼罩在一片神秘的氛围中。
Plot Correspondence.en: As night falls, the sacred city of Vaes Dothrak is shrouded in a mysterious atmosphere.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 维斯·多斯拉克, 神秘氛围, 辽阔的草原, 远处的帐篷和篝火, 微弱的月光
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, Vaes Dothrak, mysterious atmosphere, vast grasslands, distant tents and bonfires, faint moonlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 辽阔的草原上，圣城维斯·多斯拉克的轮廓在夜色中若隐若现，远处的帐篷闪烁着微弱的火光。
Static Shot Description.en: The outline of the sacred city of Vaes Dothrak is faintly visible in the night, with distant tents glowing faintly from bonfires.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 年轻的丹妮莉丝，身怀六甲，站在一个火坑旁。
Plot Correspondence.en: Young Daenerys, heavily pregnant, stands beside a fire pit.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 紧张氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, tense atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝站在火坑旁，双手捧着冒着热气的马心，表情凝重，火光映照在她白皙的脸上。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys stands by the fire pit, holding a steaming horse heart in her hands, her expression solemn, the firelight reflecting on her fair face.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 她的丈夫卓戈卡奥，刚刚杀死了一匹野马，将血淋淋的心脏递给她。
Plot Correspondence.en: Her husband, Khal Drogo, has just killed a wild horse and hands her the bloody heart.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 紧张氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, tense atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Static Shot Description.ch: 卓戈卡奥站在丹妮莉丝身旁，身材魁梧，手中握着血淋淋的马心，表情冷酷。
Static Shot Description.en: Khal Drogo stands beside Daenerys, his muscular frame holding the bloody horse heart, his expression cold and stern.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 丹妮莉丝强忍着恶心，咬了下去。鲜血顺着她的下巴流下，她艰难地咀嚼着生肉。
Plot Correspondence.en: Daenerys suppresses her nausea and takes a bite. Blood drips down her chin as she struggles to chew the raw meat.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 紧张氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, tense atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝紧闭双眼，咬下马心，鲜血顺着下巴流下，表情痛苦而坚定。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys closes her eyes as she bites into the horse heart, blood running down her chin, her expression pained but resolute.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 她抬起头，看到多希卡林的老妪们正注视着她。
Plot Correspondence.en: She looks up and sees the Dosh Khaleen elders watching her.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 神秘氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, mysterious atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝抬头，多希卡林的老妪们站在她面前，眼神锐利，表情严肃。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys looks up to see the Dosh Khaleen elders standing before her, their sharp eyes and stern expressions fixed on her.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 最年迈的一位老妪高举双手，宣布丹妮莉丝怀的是个男孩，并将成为“骑着世界的骏马”。
Plot Correspondence.en: The eldest of the elders raises her hands and declares that Daenerys is carrying a boy, who will be 'the stallion who mounts the world.'

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 神秘氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, mysterious atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 最年迈的老妪高举双手，表情庄重，宣布预言，其他老妪围绕在她身旁。
Static Shot Description.en: The eldest elder raises her hands, her expression solemn as she delivers the prophecy, the other elders gathered around her.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 人群欢呼起来，丹妮莉丝感到一丝安慰。
Plot Correspondence.en: The crowd cheers, and Daenerys feels a glimmer of comfort.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 火坑旁, 欢庆氛围, 燃烧的篝火, 地上的血迹, 火光映照
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, beside the fire pit, celebratory atmosphere, burning bonfire, bloodstains on the ground, firelight illuminating the scene

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝站在中央，周围人群欢呼雀跃，她脸上露出一丝欣慰的微笑。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys stands at the center, surrounded by cheering people, a faint smile of relief on her face.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 仪式结束后，丹妮莉丝和卓戈卡奥回到他们的宫殿。宫殿里正在举行盛大的宴会。
Plot Correspondence.en: After the ceremony, Daenerys and Khal Drogo return to their palace, where a grand feast is underway.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 欢庆氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 音乐和鼓声, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, celebratory atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, music and drumbeats, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝和卓戈卡奥并肩走入宫殿，宴会正在进行，人们欢声笑语，音乐和鼓声交织。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys and Khal Drogo walk side by side into the palace, where the feast is in full swing, people laughing and chatting, music and drumbeats filling the air.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 然而，丹妮莉丝的哥哥韦赛里斯却不见踪影。
Plot Correspondence.en: However, Daenerys' brother Viserys is nowhere to be seen.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 欢庆氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 音乐和鼓声, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, celebratory atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, music and drumbeats, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝环顾四周，表情略显担忧，寻找韦赛里斯的身影。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys looks around, her expression slightly worried as she searches for Viserys.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 过了一会儿，韦赛里斯出现了，他喝得烂醉如泥，手里还拿着一把剑。
Plot Correspondence.en: After a while, Viserys appears, drunken and stumbling, a sword in his hand.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 音乐和鼓声渐弱, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, music and drumbeats fading, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 韦赛里斯摇摇晃晃地走来，手中握着剑，表情疯狂，眼神迷离。
Static Shot Description.en: Viserys staggers forward, sword in hand, his expression wild and his gaze unfocused.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 韦赛里斯的行为引起了公愤，人们开始朝他叫嚷。
Plot Correspondence.en: Viserys' behavior incites public outrage, and people begin shouting at him.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 音乐和鼓声停止, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, music and drumbeats stopped, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 韦赛里斯站在中央，周围人群愤怒地叫嚷，气氛紧张。
Static Shot Description.en: Viserys stands in the center, surrounded by angry shouting from the crowd, the atmosphere growing tense.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 丹妮莉丝感到恐惧，她试图劝说哥哥，但韦赛里斯已经失去了理智。
Plot Correspondence.en: Daenerys feels fear as she tries to reason with her brother, but Viserys has lost all sense.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝面对韦赛里斯，表情惊恐，试图劝说，但韦赛里斯挥舞着剑，无视她的话语。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys faces Viserys, her expression fearful as she tries to speak reason, but Viserys ignores her, waving his sword wildly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 卓戈卡奥从高位上走下来，他的血盟卫抓住了韦赛里斯。
Plot Correspondence.en: Khal Drogo descends from his throne, and his bloodriders seize Viserys.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 卓戈卡奥从高位走下，血盟卫抓住韦赛里斯，韦赛里斯挣扎但无济于事。
Static Shot Description.en: Khal Drogo steps down from his throne, his bloodriders grabbing Viserys, who struggles helplessly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 卓戈卡奥将他的金腰带扔进一个烧得通红的铁锅里。
Plot Correspondence.en: Khal Drogo throws his golden belt into a red-hot iron pot.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 烧红的铁锅, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, glowing iron pot, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 卓戈卡奥将金腰带扔进烧红的铁锅，表情冷酷，火焰映照在他脸上。
Static Shot Description.en: Khal Drogo throws the golden belt into the red-hot iron pot, his expression cold and stern, the flames reflecting on his face.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 等黄金融化后，他用马毛手套抓起锅子，将滚烫的黄金浇在韦赛里斯的头上。
Plot Correspondence.en: Once the gold has melted, he takes the pot with a horsehair glove and pours the molten gold over Viserys' head.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 烧红的铁锅, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, glowing iron pot, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 卓戈卡奥用马毛手套抓起铁锅，将滚烫的黄金浇在韦赛里斯头上，韦赛里斯表情极度痛苦。
Static Shot Description.en: Khal Drogo lifts the iron pot with a horsehair glove, pouring the molten gold over Viserys' head, Viserys' face contorted in agony.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 韦赛里斯发出撕心裂肺的惨叫，他的身体在泥地上抽搐了几下，然后不动了。
Plot Correspondence.en: Viserys lets out a bloodcurdling scream, his body convulsing on the muddy ground before going still.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 紧张氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 地上的血迹, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, tense atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, bloodstains on the ground, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 韦赛里斯倒在地上，身体抽搐，发出惨叫，最终不动了，周围一片寂静。
Static Shot Description.en: Viserys collapses to the ground, his body convulsing as he screams, before falling still, the room silent.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 丹妮莉丝看着这一幕，心中充满了悲伤和绝望。
Plot Correspondence.en: Daenerys watches this scene, her heart filled with sorrow and despair.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 悲伤氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 地上的血迹, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, sorrowful atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, bloodstains on the ground, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝看着韦赛里斯的尸体，表情悲伤而绝望，泪水在眼眶中打转。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys gazes at Viserys' lifeless body, her expression sorrowful and despairing, tears welling in her eyes.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 但她也明白了：韦赛里斯不是真龙，因为真龙不怕火。
Plot Correspondence.en: But she also understands: Viserys was not the true dragon, for true dragons are not afraid of fire.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 悲伤氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 地上的血迹, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, sorrowful atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, bloodstains on the ground, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 丹妮莉丝低头沉思，表情逐渐坚定，仿佛明白了什么。
Static Shot Description.en: Daenerys lowers her head in thought, her expression gradually firming as if she has realized something.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 宫殿内一片寂静，人们震惊地看着这一幕。
Plot Correspondence.en: The palace is silent, the crowd staring in shock at the scene.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚, 宫殿内, 震惊氛围, 装饰华丽的宫殿, 宴会桌, 地上的血迹, 火把照明
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside the palace, shocked atmosphere, ornately decorated palace, banquet tables, bloodstains on the ground, torchlight

Static Shot Description.ch: 宫殿内一片寂静，人们震惊地看着韦赛里斯的尸体，表情各异。
Static Shot Description.en: The palace is utterly silent, the crowd staring in shock at Viserys' body, their expressions a mix of horror and disbelief.
